title: Nested Frames at Dusk
description: A man in a brown coat and hat sits on the threshold of a series of receding, dilapidated wooden frames, looking toward a purple and orange sunset over a distant forest. Translucent ribbons and bubbles in shades of purple, blue, and teal float through the scene, while the outermost frame shows heavy peeling paint and decay.
prompt: A solitary man wearing a brown hat and green scarf sits with his back to the viewer on the wooden threshold of multiple receding empty picture frames. He gazes at a purple and orange sunset over a pine forest. Translucent flowing ribbons and floating bubbles in purple, blue and teal drift through the scene. The outermost frame is heavily weathered with peeling white and green paint. Surreal symbolic atmosphere, detailed textures, painterly style.
